about_the_game:
This DLC adds cool and confident Shinjuku Waifu Mari Bradbury to the roster of enjoyable Waifus in Waifu Rancher 2.

Stunning and Confident Mari Bradbury

A stunning Waifu from Shinjuku, Mari is Mira's older sister and shares the same exotic Japanese accent and taste for azures and indigos.

These two sisters couldn't be more different, though. Mari is confident, self-assured and easygoing, while her sister Mira is shy and possessive. 

You'll have a hard time stopping once you've started spending time with Mari.

This DLC includes:

  • Playable Waifu Mari with 3 outfits

  • Over 60 new images

  • Over 100 new voice lines including over 60 lewd voice lines

content_descriptors.notes: Contains lewd voice lines, gratifying vocalizations and depictions of adult female characters in in-context, revealing outfits and poses.
